create_ManagedAttribute_with_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor that enforces a specific type when setting values on a class
create_ManagedAttribute_without_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor with no type enforcement for flexible attribute access
review_ManagedAttribute_descriptor: review the ManagedAttribute class to understand how it implements the Python descriptor protocol
refactor_ManagedAttribute_type_check: refactor the ManagedAttribute __set__ method to support multiple allowed types instead of a single enforced type
test_ManagedAttribute_get_set: test the ManagedAttribute descriptor by setting and getting values on a Runner or Reducer instance
